project_type: Python stdlib-only cross-domain structural analogy engine plus zero-dependency local app (http.server, SQLite, bundled JS UI, CLI). FastAPI/SQLAlchemy code under backend/api, backend/database is UNVERIFIED and not runnable here.
language: Python 3.11 (stdlib only for engine and app); vanilla JS UI in backend/isomorph_app/static
build_system: No build step. `python3 ./isomorph serve` runs the app. pyproject.toml and Makefile exist.
test_framework: pytest under backend/tests/intelligence and backend/tests/platform; helpers in tests/intelligence/helpers.py; ui_helpers.test.mjs run by a platform test
verification_instructions: Run pytest (baseline 288 passed, 2 skipped), then python3 scripts/run_demo.py, evaluate_benchmarks.py (tuning MRR 0.9286), evaluate_heldout.py (MRR 0.975, ndcg@10 0.8324), evaluate_perception.py (role_accuracy 0.404, precision 0.857, recall 0.846), validate_seed_data.py. Record before/after numbers.
snapshot_or_generated_files: data/benchmark_problems/perception_heldout_baseline.json (only rewritten with --write-baseline; do NOT rewrite). heldout_labels.json, perception_heldout.json and benchmarks.json are FROZEN: never edit them.
setup_instructions: None needed. No pip or npm installs possible.
environment_constraints: No network, no pip/npm, no Postgres, no browser, no Docker. FastAPI/SQLAlchemy paths cannot be executed: mark UNVERIFIED. UI JS can only be checked with node on pure helper modules (lib.js) if node exists.
contribution_requirements: Read .kiro/steering/*.md (data-integrity, ai-integration-rules, testing-requirements, coding-conventions). Honest reporting: no fabricated numbers, no AGI claims. No em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: Dataclass schemas in intelligence/schemas; perception/service.py has LEXICON, SYNONYMS, resolve_unknown_role, ROLE_SOURCE_CONFIDENCE, _role_index (seed-derived index); learning_engine/service.py MemoryStore with unconditional prior_adjustment; pipeline.investigate takes memory; services/orchestrator.py _perception stage; isomorph_app/app.py App wires SqliteDatabase, annotations (accept/reject/etc per hypothesis), server.py _route regex dispatch under /api/v1; cli.py subcommands; time is injected in learning code for reproducibility.
